newsitem.title: USA: Norwood says sees Q4 EPS $0.20 vs $0.25.
newsitem.headline: Norwood says sees Q4 EPS $0.20 vs $0.25.

text.p: Norwood Promotional Products Inc said Thursday it expects to report earnings of about $0.20 to $0.25 per share for its fourth quarter, and $1.00 to $1.05 for its fiscal year ending August 31.
The company said these expectations are based on recent trends at its Alpha division, and information available to date.
The company said that without the results of its Alpha division, which it said hurt its earnings, it would report $0.25 to $0.30 per share for the fourth quarter, and $1.30 to $1.35 for the year.
The company last year reported operating earnings per share for the quarter of $0.20 before a charge of $983,000. Including the charge, earnings per share were $0.03.
The company reported third quarter earnings per share of $0.52, compared to $0.44 for the same period a year ago.
